item.title: Heard in the Reef, from Polmachos #4522: "They say the field at the Burning Lake of Eridan
item.description: Heard in the Reef, from Polmachos #4522: "They say the field at the Burning Lake of Eridanus ran with marrow. They say the Dodonaioi were behind it. The augurs say it was foretold."
